note: Crawford County's official parcel map is a Schneider Beacon viewer (Cloudflare-blocked, no public REST endpoint found) and a Breeze GIS app with no discoverable service URL. The county auditor GIS page links only the viewer, no downloadable parcels or ArcGIS REST services. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches found no Crawford County parcel FeatureServer or MapServer. Parcel data otherwise comes only from commercial vendors (Dynamo, Regrid, Equator, Rockford).
